page_title: UNI 0-0 RBL | Union Berlin v RB Leipzig 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+6' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. RB Leipzig force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+5' A yellow card is awarded to Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin).

90+5' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

89' That's unlucky! Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
88' The corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is intercepted by the defence.
86' A lofted cross from Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
84' Steffen Baumgart has decided to make a change. Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) replaces Robert Skov.
84' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
78' Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christoph Baumgartner trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig).
77' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) replacing Janik Haberer.
72' Substitution. Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) in, Ridle Baku out.
72' Nicolas Seiwald comes off the pitch to be replaced by Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig).
72' A substitution has been made. Josip Juranovic goes off and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes on.
72' Steffen Baumgart decides to make a substitution. Ivan Prtajin will be replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
71' We are about to witness a subsitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) for Tim Skarke.
70' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
68' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Peter Gulacsi, who makes a comfortable save.
66' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
65' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
64' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Schlager interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' Yellow card. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
63' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

60' Union Berlin slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
55' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
53' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
49' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Schlager and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Ivan Prtajin (Union Berlin) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Peter Gulacsi.
46' Marco Rose has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Antonio Nusa comes on the pitch for Lois Openda (RB Leipzig).
46' The game is over for El Chadaille Bitshiabu (RB Leipzig). Amadou Haidara comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Daniel Schlager has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Union Berlin force their opponents to concede a corner.
43' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
42' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Peter Gulacsi, who pulls off a stunning save!

41' OFF THE POST! Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
39' Robert Skov (Union Berlin) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
35' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a chip pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow is quickest to intercept the ball.
34' Ivan Prtajin (Union Berlin) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
32' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
31' Ivan Prtajin (Union Berlin) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
30' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
28' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner with a short pass.
27' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
26' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post.
25' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar.
23' Ivan Prtajin (Union Berlin) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes well wide of the left post.
19' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Peter Gulacsi is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
18' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

13' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
13' David Raum (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
12' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
12' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
10' A cross into the box from Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
7' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
2' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half has started.
RB Leipzig will kick-off.
Daniel Schlager was nominated as the referee for this game.
